name: Morning briefing
description: Daily AM readout for the owner. The one job: the decision to make today, in the first 30 seconds. Lead with the recommendation, then the horizon, then concise summaries - never an exec summary that recaps everything.
audio: 2-3 min companion narration in the same order as the deck; spell out acronyms and ids for TTS (read ESRD as E.S.R.D., say the issue number aloud as 'issue 128', never as a bare ref).

sections.name: Title
sections.guide: "What to do today" + date + one-line framing.

sections.name: Recommended today
sections.guide: The 1-3 actions/decisions, each with a one-line why. Tag verbs: BUILD / DECIDE / PARALLEL. This is the slide that matters.

sections.name: On the horizon
sections.guide: The active gate + what's next. Two columns: blockers vs what-comes-after.

sections.name: Since last briefing, at a glance
What shipped
sections.guide: The headline arc first, secondary arcs grouped; 4 bullets max per slide. Skippable by design - detail lives here so the decision slides stay clean. Scale to the day's volume.

sections.name: The line for today
sections.guide: Hero callout: the ask, restated in one sentence.
